changes: Shared strict three-metric comparison gate; each validator retains its original tolerance and report schema.
Shared copied-shape placement composition; world_shape keeps its distinct replacement semantics.
FreeCAD preview lifecycle and failure-state recording separated from AppImage dispatch.
Regression coverage for tolerance boundaries, nonfinite differences, placement order/aliasing and preview error provenance.
preserved: Geometry, dimensions, parts and purchased hardware
Local/world placements, hierarchy and saved contracts
Expressions, registries and all 27 main native control cases
Validation decisions, measurements and report keys

report_comparison.scope: Every field of all top-level build JSON reports except preview_state.json; preview freshness is checked separately. Only exact recorded source/artifact hash changes in explicit provenance fields are accepted. Duplicate keys are rejected; file inventory and all deltas are rechecked.

native_tests.prior_attempt: Stopped after export-integrity tests exposed a missing placed_shape attribute in their fake CAD module. Test stub updated without changing assertions or application code; full suite restarted. Both attempts retained.

blender.scope: All exported integer-frame native samples, exact CAD-part inventories and visibility, and scene object/action isolation. CAD millimetres become metres with a global X half-turn. Quaternion sign continuity is checked between samples. No continuous-time interpolation, collision, physics, or source-CAD freshness certification is claimed.

limitations: Preserves the geometric prototype; no additional physical, electrical, wire-flex, structural or flight qualification.

retained_evidence.format: gzip JSON: complete native test evidence, reports, old/new comparisons and audit programs

independent_report_review.scope: Reviewed hardened final comparison programs and all changed report paths; independently parsed and recursively compared all nine old/new top-level build JSON reports except separately checked preview_state.json. Checked schema, primitive types, list lengths, scalar differences, report inventory, exact digest pairs, and retained evidence identity.
independent_report_review.accepted_changes: All 66 differences occur in reviewed provenance/hash fields and match verified old/new source fingerprints or exact file digest pairs.
independent_report_review.audit_hardening_review: Duplicate JSON keys are rejected; current report inventory is asserted; deltas are recomputed; accepted digest changes require explicit provenance fields. Earlier audit-strength concerns are resolved for these captured reports.
independent_report_review.retained_evidence_review: Archive SHA256 matches verification manifest; retained final diff/review and comparison programs match the inspected files.
independent_report_review.limits: No native suite or pipeline rerun was performed during this final independent report review.
